reason: This PR changes a core query operator end-to-end: TopN planning, physical plan construction, task lowering, index resolution, executor building, executor runtime, and even chunk handling. TopN sits on common query paths, and 'inline projection' can hide high-severity correctness bugs in projected columns, ORDER BY semantics, expression evaluation, and runtime row/chunk handling. The broad planner/executor surface plus many plan/result golden updates makes it worth a focused deep review.
